In addition, Zhou et al. recently discovered that the structural changes can alter the conformational antigenic epitopes of profilin allergen (Bra c p) from Brassica campestris bee pollen, decreasing its allergenicity (Zhou et al., 2023). In conclusion, there is increasing evidence that the innate immune response plays a crucial role in developing allergic diseases and that quercetin can modulate innate immunity through multiple mechanisms.
However, Singh et al. showed that quercetin administration reinforces the Th2 immune response by increasing IgG1 antibody levels in OVA-immunized mice. It also upregulated the expression of Tbx21, GATA-3, and Oct-2 proteins in splenocytes (Singh et al., 2017).
